privacy_body_1: The text, images and speech-recognition results you enter are sent to the Google Gemini API in order to be translated.
privacy_body_2: History, favorites, glossary and chats are stored only in this device's browser, not on the server.
privacy_body_3: The server records only usage totals (counts and error types) and short-lived request counters to prevent abuse. Translated content is not recorded.
privacy_body_4: A cookie is used to remember your language settings.
data_hint: History, favorites, glossary and chats are stored only in this device's browser. Export a backup now and then, in case you change phones or the browser clears its data.
backup_remind: You have not backed up for a while. Export one before your data gets lost.
import_confirm: Add {h} history items, {g} glossary entries and {c} chat messages to your current data? (Your current data is kept.)
import_bad: This file cannot be imported (not a TOOKIE backup, or it is damaged).
import_big: The file is too large (max 5 MB).
data_delete: Delete all data on this device
data_delete_confirm: This deletes your history, favorites, glossary, chats and language settings. It cannot be undone. Have you exported a backup first?
storage_unprotected: · Storage protection: off (the browser may delete data when storage runs low)
phrase_note: Common travel phrases. They are ready-made (not AI-translated), so they work without a connection.
phrase_load_failed: Could not load the phrases. Open the app once while online, then try again.
install_ios: In Safari, tap the Share button (a square with an up arrow) and choose "Add to Home Screen" to launch TOOKIE like an app.
install_android: Use the button below to add TOOKIE to your home screen.
offline_hint: Translation needs an internet connection. History, favorites, glossary and the phrasebook are stored on this device and work without one.
offline_banner: You are offline. Translation is unavailable, but you can still use
